agent.cli.usage:
Usage: specboard-agent <role>
  serve     main process: keeps the project database and the core and stays resident (attach or start launches it)
  attach    path for each connection: hands the app's lines to the main process (the SpecBoard app launches it over SSH)
  start     start the main process (from the host's shell; left as it is when running)
  stop      stop the main process
  status    whether the main process is running (and whether MCP is listening)
  port <n>  change the port the main process listens on for MCP (kept in the user's settings)
